memory_candidates.content: In the BXCanonical completeness proof, the enriched chain with BX11 fold preserves F-obligations forever but BX11 perpetual deferral prevents guaranteeing a specific formula is eventually resolved. This is the irreducible obstruction after 30 research rounds.

The quasimodel infrastructure handles Until/Since defect discharge via hintikka_step and defect_count, NOT F-formula resolution. Bridging quasimodel chains to F-obligation resolution requires construction not present in codebase.

The perpetual deferral set P argument for forward_F almost works: if phi in P, at each visit step the BX11 fold resolves some w not_in P (since w in chain(v+1) contradicts P membership). But transient defects can oscillate indefinitely, providing decoy resolutions that never force P to be empty.

The BX11 fold (enriched_fwd_step/resolving_enriched_fwd_exists) preserves F-obligations at every step via disjunctive results, but .choose from the existential can perpetually defer any specific formula. The defect count does NOT decrease because phi_in_mcs_imp_F_phi ensures F(psi) persists whenever psi is present.

backward_until_from_step parameterizes backward Until coherence over a step transfer property that is NOT derivable from bare FMCS structure. The step transfer depends on either forward_F or chain-level enrichment.
The 6 sorry sites in RootScopedChain.lean form a dependency diamond: sorry 1 and sorry 3 are independent roots. All 6 ultimately depend on solving the forward_F chain construction problem.

The backward Until step transfer property (phi U psi in chain(r+1) AND phi in chain(r) -> phi U psi in chain(r)) requires phi AND F(phi U psi) -> phi U psi, which is NOT derivable in the BX axiom system.

For BXCanonical completeness, the three restricted coherence properties all require Until/Since coherence at the chain level. BX12 reduction converts forward_F to forward Until but both have the same perpetual deferral difficulty.
SubformulaClosure (Quasimodel) is closed under temporal unwrapping: G(chi) in Sigma implies chi in Sigma, and similarly for H and Until subformulas.

Until formula propagation through bx_le is fundamentally blocked: bx_le w v means g_content(w) subset v, which propagates G(chi) but Until formulas do NOT become G(Until) so they do not propagate. hintikka_step Until propagation clause cannot be satisfied using standard bx_forward_witness alone.

In BX temporal logic, the forward_temporal_witness_seed_consistent proof uses a G-lift technique: L' |- neg(psi) is lifted to G(L'). This G-lift ONLY works when all elements of L' are in g_content(M). Until formulas (alpha U beta) in an MCS do NOT have G(alpha U beta) in the MCS, so extending the seed with Until formulas breaks the G-lift proof.
Backward Until/Since coherence is NOT a property of general FMCS over Int. The chain construction must EXPLICITLY ensure backward Until coherence.
bx_le w v does NOT propagate Until formulas. The oracle construction must use an enriched Lindenbaum seed that explicitly includes Until defects.

active_projects.description: Redesign the FMP filtration for strict temporal semantics. The 2 sorry theorems in Decidability/FMP/TruthPreservation.lean — mcs_all_future_closure (line 263) and mcs_all_past_closure (line 281) — are deprecated because the temporal T-axiom (Gphi -> phi) is NOT valid under strict semantics. filtration_all_future_forward and filtration_all_past_forward depend on them. The FMP module is separate from the main decidability pipeline (decide is sorry-free), but completing it formally proves the finite model property. Resolution options: (A) restrict FMP statement to serial frames where temporal seriality holds, (B) redesign filtration to avoid temporal reflexivity entirely, (C) prove the filtered model satisfies a weaker correctness property sufficient for the FMP theorem. Note: mcs_finite_model_property in FMP.lean does NOT directly use these sorry lemmas, so the impact is localized to filtration_all_future_forward/backward.

Restructure ParametricRepresentation into unified STSA representation theorem. Research report 001 provides complete algebraic analysis with ~80% of formalization already existing.
